title: EventBus self-unregister + same-owner re-register idempotency recovery contract

contract.self_unregister: A callback can unregister itself during an active EventBus.emit() cycle
contract.same_callback_reregister: The same owner can re-register the same callback after self-unregister
contract.different_callback_idempotency: A subsequent registration attempt for the same owner with a different callback is idempotent and does not replace the existing callback
contract.single_owner_entry: Exactly one listener entry exists for the owner after self-recovery
contract.original_callback_preserved: The original callback remains registered after duplicate same-owner registration attempts
contract.current_cycle_continuity: The active callback receives the current broadcast exactly once
contract.current_cycle_recovery_isolation: Callbacks registered during the active broadcast do not receive that same broadcast again
contract.post_recovery_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts deliver exactly once to every registered listener
contract.registry_order_integrity: Self-removed and re-registered owner is restored at the end of the registry
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after self-recovery
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus registration, unregister, and emit operations require the events permission
